From midday on Tuesday 1 December, every gift to Step by Step through Big Give is doubled for one week. £25 becomes £50, and £100 becomes £200, at no extra cost to you.

How it works:
1. Wait until midday on Tuesday 1 December.
2. Give on our Big Give page. Only gifts made there are doubled.
3. Tick Gift Aid if you're a UK taxpayer.

captions.ig:
Every four minutes, a young person in the UK faces homelessness.

It doesn't have to be that way. A safe home, the right support and someone in their corner can stop it happening, not just pick up the pieces. That's what we do, every day, across the South of England.

From midday on 1 December, every gift to Step by Step is doubled for one week. Make a donation promise: link in bio.

#TakeAStand #BigGive #ChristmasChallenge #YouthHomelessness
captions.fb:
Every four minutes, a young person in the UK faces homelessness. That's 123,934 young people last year (Centrepoint Databank 2024-25).

It doesn't have to be that way. With a safe home, the right support and someone in their corner, youth homelessness can be prevented. That's what Step by Step does across Hampshire, Surrey, Dorset, Berkshire, Wiltshire and West Sussex.

Lodges, churches, clubs, schools and offices have always stood with Step by Step. This Christmas, your group can go twice as far.

From midday on 1 December to midday on 8 December, every gift through our Big Give page is doubled. Hold a collection, a bake sale or a Christmas jumper day, then give it together while it's doubled.

Giving £500 or more as a group? A bank transfer is easiest. Set up a free Big Give donor account and transfer before 1 December, as it can take five working days.

Tell us you're taking part and we'll thank you here: fundraising@stepbystep.org.uk
